name: East Rennell
description: East Rennell occupies the southern third of Rennell Island, the southernmost of the Solomon Islands, and belongs to the world's largest raised coral atoll. Its old lagoon is now Lake Tegano, the biggest lake in the insular Pacific, a brackish expanse dotted with rugged limestone islands and home to species found nowhere else. Dense forest and frequent cyclones shape the land, which local communities still own and manage.
